text:
My soul is a princess shut inside her tower,

with five little windows to look at life.

It is a sad goddess that the body imprisoned.

and your soul, which flew from before you died,

is a magnificent wing, free of every shackle...

You are not the ghost: the ghost is I!


What do I understand of things! Things are offered to me,

not as they are in themselves, but as they appear

to the five senses with which God limited

my coarse sensorium, my diminished perception.

You know everything today..., I, by contrast, know nothing!

You are not the ghost: the ghost is I!

translation.title: The Ghost and I
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the five windows as senses and reverses ghostliness onto the speaker.
